pack.description: The forward effects as 0.44a5 draws them, with client patch 169: a DXT1 transparency map (CONFIG_USE_OLTA) and the distortion of the emissive map alone (CONFIG_USE_FUZZINESS) in the masks of forward_base and offscreen_particle_lighting, players' programs under their wider keys, and the forward, particle lighting and z-shifted vertex programs players lack from 0.44a5 (from 0.32a4 where 0.44a5 has none of the key) (0.26g with patch 169 sets constant_tile_uv as a float4 and probe_diffuse_mult)

vertex_base_z_shifted.vs.why: 0.44a5 sets the displacement constants and map only in its g-buffer compile (0x4C1FC0: displacement_tile 0x4C2CF6, displacement_scale 0x4C2D63, t_displacement 0x4C2F02), never in forward_default's (0x4BC960), whose tiling bit selects these two programs (vertex inputs 1 and 2): they read 0 there, and 0.26g's zeroed constant buffers and unbound texture give the same
